name: Ikeda Kana
source: Kana is a second-year at Kazekoshi Girls' High School and a member of the mahjong team who plays as the team's captain. She has triplet younger sisters who look exactly like her. She is a cheerful, cat-like girl and has great confidence in her mahjong skill. Kana is shown to be very fond of [url=/c35500]Mihoko[/url] and loves to be petted by her. She has proclaimed that there is none who is more annoying than she is. She has also shown to be very stubborn. Kana is very cat-like, sprouting ears and a tail at any given time, and she also purrs. Despite this, she is often scolded and almost even abused by their coach for her minor mistakes.
